ar.title: الكفتة بالصلصة

steps.n1: يتبل اللحم المفروم بالشبت والثوم والبقسماط والتوابل ويعجن جيدا.
steps.n2: تكوَر حسب الرغبة إما أصابع أو دوائر.
steps.n4: تجهز صلصة مثل صلصة المكرونة (قسم النشويات).
steps.n5: بعد غليان الصلصة توضع فيها الكفتة على درجة حرارة هادئة حتى النضج.

en.title: Kofta in Sauce

steps.n1: Season the ground meat with dill, garlic, breadcrumbs, and spices, then knead well.
steps.n2: Shape into fingers or rounds as desired.
steps.n4: Prepare a sauce similar to pasta sauce (starch section).
steps.n5: Once the sauce comes to a boil, add the kofta and simmer on low heat until cooked through.

legacySteps: Season the ground meat with dill, garlic, breadcrumbs, and spices, then knead well.
Shape into fingers or rounds as desired.

Once the sauce comes to a boil, add the kofta and simmer on low heat until cooked through.
